queries:
SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share
FROM telescopes
GROUP BY observstation
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT o.observstation,
       COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count,
       COALESCE(1.0 * COUNT(t.telescregistry) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0), 0) AS share
FROM observatories o
LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
GROUP BY o.observstation
ORDER BY telescope_count DESC, o.observstation
LIMIT 10;
SELECT COUNT(observstation) AS total FROM telescopes
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation;

SELECT t.observstation, COUNT(DISTINCT t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
FROM telescopes t
JOIN signals s ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
GROUP BY t.observstation
